### 🛠 Fixes & Improvements

- Pressing Backspace immediately after a marker positioned at the end of a line now steps backward into the marker instead of leaving the document unchanged.
- Updated the CodeMirror editor libraries and the Lezer Markdown parser.
- Updated Capacitor runtime libraries and Android integration packages, including keyboard handling.
- Upgraded the application bundler and Progressive Web App tooling to Vite 8 and vite-plugin-pwa 2.
- Updated the Lucide icon library to the latest release.

📋 [Changelog](https://github.com/ScottKirvan/QuKi-Notes/blob/main/notes/CHANGELOG.md)
